name: bespunky-browser-automation
description: BeSpunky browser automation. `playwright` — drive a real browser headless (load, click, type, screenshot, scrape) for solo verification, bug repro, or repeatable scripts. `shared-browser` — one in-container Chromium the human watches and clicks over noVNC while Claude drives it over loopback CDP: co-debugging, live CSS/DOM verification with measured proof, pairing on a flow. Pre-installed and enabled in BeSpunky devcontainers.
